
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(here)
```

```{r}
# Read the first 1456 rows to capture the standard single-turnover metrics
photophys <- read.csv(here("Data", "AS26_PhenotypingData_expt.csv"), row.names = 1)
photophys <- photophys[1:1456, ] 

# Load the matching cluster configuration
load(here("Data", "cbb_AS26_expt_1000bs_updated.RData"))
sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("Data", "AS26_MAPPmetadata_expt.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Clean labels from original tree to sync names correctly
dend_ids <- cbb$hclust$labels %>%
  tolower() %>%
  str_replace("\\.processed\\.csv$", "") %>%
  str_replace("\\._?\\d{2,3}r$", "") %>%
  trimws()

longphoto_shortie <- photophys %>% 
  select(-c(uni, metrix)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(metric, stage, col),
    names_to = "SampleID",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!str_starts(metric, "m")) %>% # Drop multiple turnover tracking metrics
  filter(
    !(startsWith(SampleID, "t7") & grepl("icra|ahya", SampleID) & grepl("005", SampleID)),
    !(startsWith(SampleID, "t7") & grepl("aglo|aabr", SampleID) & grepl("002", SampleID))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID_clean = SampleID %>%
      tolower() %>%
      str_replace("\\.processed\\.csv$", "") %>%
      str_replace("\\._?\\d{2,3}r$", "") %>%
      trimws()
  ) %>%
  filter(SampleID_clean %in% dend_ids)
```

```{r}
# Pivot the clean variables wide
longphoto_wide <- longphoto_shortie %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(stage, col, SampleID, SampleID_clean),
    names_from = metric,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Fo, -Fm)

# Extract cluster configurations from the tree strictly for plotting visualization
cluster_results <- lapply(2:15, function(k) {
  clusters <- cutree(cbb$hclust, k = k)
  data.frame(
    SampleID = names(clusters),
    Cluster = as.integer(clusters),
    k = k
  )
})

cluster_df_all <- bind_rows(cluster_results) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = k,
    values_from = Cluster,
    names_prefix = "K_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID_clean = SampleID %>%
      tolower() %>%
      str_replace("\\.processed\\.csv$", "") %>%
      str_replace("\\._?\\d{2,3}r$", "") %>%
      trimws()
  )

# Join assignments
df_with_clusters <- longphoto_wide %>%
  left_join(cluster_df_all, by = "SampleID_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    site = str_remove(str_extract(SampleID_clean, "^t\\d+"), "t"),
    species = str_extract(SampleID_clean, "(?<=_)[:alpha:]+"),
    genotype = str_extract(SampleID_clean, "\\d+$")
  )
```

```{r}
# CRITICAL: We name these distinct from your main analysis pipeline files 
write.csv(df_with_clusters, file = here("Data", "traces_data_with_clusters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cluster_summary_traces <- df_with_clusters %>%
  distinct(SampleID_clean, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  dplyr::select(SampleID_clean, site, species, genotype, K_2:K_15)

write.csv(cluster_summary_traces, file = here("Data", "traces_cluster_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

df_numeric <- df_with_clusters
df_numeric[, 5:18] <- lapply(df_numeric[, 5:18], function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Calculate group means using K_3 cluster column specifically
sum_photo_long <- df_numeric %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cluster = K_3) %>%  
  group_by(stage, col, Cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(stage, col, Cluster),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  )

# CLEAN FILTER STEP: Keep only the base 9 short names
sub_photo <- sum_photo_long %>% 
  # Strip out any summary text prefixes (like mean.1., max.1.) if they attached to the metrics
  mutate(Metric = stringr::str_replace(Metric, "^.*(ABQ|Connect|NPQ|qm|qP|Quant|Sigma|Tau1|Tau2).*$", "\\1")) %>%
  # Keep only the exact target base metrics
  filter(Metric %in% c("ABQ", "Connect", "NPQ", "qm", "qP", "Quant", "Sigma", "Tau1", "Tau2")) %>%
  filter(!col %in% c('All', 'Ratio12', 'Ratio32', 'Ratio42')) %>% 
  mutate(stage = as.numeric(as.character(stage))) %>% 
  filter(stage >= 1 & stage <= 27) %>% 
  arrange(stage) %>%
  mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster))

# Render the clean, short 3x9 grid
ggplot(sub_photo) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = stage, y = Value, group = interaction(col, Cluster), colour = col)) + 
  facet_grid(Metric ~ Cluster, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```
